reviewScope: Official Nepal EPS website notice pages/titles checked through 2026-10-13, cohort and sector isolation; no title-only rule promotion
reviewLimitations: The 2026-07-26 urgent applicant PDF is approximately 24.46 MB and its complete contents could not be obtained for text review; no exact rules were promoted.
The 2026-07-30 online-submission/passport notice is visible by official page title but the substantive scan/image content has not been reviewed.
Root Industry 2026 selection notices are a separate program; same-year notices must not be merged into first-phase general Manufacturing.
2026 regular/committed-worker departure announcements do not establish that 2026 first-phase EPS-TOPIK applicants have completed recruitment.
Nepal official notice index and search caches can lag; this is a dated review, not live regulatory monitoring.

notices.title: 2026 first-phase EPS-TOPIK registration announcement (Manufacturing included)
notices.ruleImpact: 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-02 registration under Nepal primary notice; now closed. HRD Korea cross-source deadline discrepancy remains unresolved.

notices.title: Urgent information for Korean-language exam applicants
notices.ruleImpact: The three-page notice sets operational safeguards for one-passport registration, duplicate-payment prevention, correction process, and applicant identity checks. The following user-guide pages are reference only. This notice alone does not establish an extension.
notices.sourceAccess: Full 15-page, 24,459,715-byte official PDF downloaded; scanned notice pages 1–3 visually reviewed; pages 4–15 are an attached application guide not promoted into current applicant actions.

notices.title: Temporary suspension of online EPS registration
notices.ruleImpact: A temporary suspension was announced; no extension or restart date inferred from this alone.

notices.title: Resumption of EPS online application service
notices.ruleImpact: Online service resumed; no new application deadline inferred.

notices.title: Online application submission / passport additional notice
notices.ruleImpact: This July 30 official EPS Nepal image explicitly extends the initial 2026 registration deadline through August 5, 2026. Expired original passport details could be entered for online registration, with a valid passport required by later Job Application Form after language and skill tests. Window remains closed now.
notices.sourceAccess: Original image embedded as base64 JPEG in EPS Nepal official post HTML, visually reviewed 2026-10-13; not inferred from title.

notices.title: Employment application notice for 2025 Manufacturing applicants
notices.ruleImpact: Never use this application period, medical or document requirement as the 2026 first-phase notice.

notices.title: Regular Manufacturing worker departure notice for 2026-10-05
notices.ruleImpact: A departure notice exists; does not demonstrate 2026 first-phase Manufacturing language-test applicants are departing.

notices.title: Regular worker departure notice for 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-13
notices.ruleImpact: Departure dates are for regular workers; do not infer any exam, Skill & Competency or job-application status of the 2026 first-phase cohort.

notices.title: Root Industry 2026 alternative-candidate selection (serial number 52)
notices.ruleImpact: This concerns 2026 Root Industry alternative selection, not the 2026 first-phase general Manufacturing EPS-TOPIK examination or Skill & Competency schedule.

notices.title: Root Industry 2026 alternative-candidate selection
notices.ruleImpact: Same calendar year is not sufficient for cohort/sector identity. Do not promote this Root Industry selection notice as a Manufacturing registration or selection rule.
